notes:
- Set separate start and end points on closed Zigzag and Blanket outlines. The outline routes to its cover seam within the stitched border and finishes at the chosen end point.
- Closed Zigzag outlines apply the standard Center Run underlay in one lap, removing the extra pass around the border.
- Zigzag outline Tatami underlay keeps its inset relative to the original border when pull compensation widens the cover. Double Tatami follows the outline through turns, with cleaner transitions and support for its backstitch and density settings.
